description:
How two conventions relate: their common ancestor in hashn's groups, what separates them on the way down
        (e.g. agent › with vs agent › for, with what each means), and the dimension names they share or have alone
        (0.72.0: no axes or aspects). A shared name can mean different things: get_convention says what each means.
